items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet ruled out with knee injury (carted, thumbs up).
items.why: Knee injury during TNF vs NE.
items.implication: Immediate TE vacuum in Bears offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/snaps for Colston Loveland and other TEs/WRs.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited.
items.why: Exited Thursday practice with new calf issue; midweek soft-tissue often risky.
items.implication: Availability vs LV uncertain; with Adams already out long-term, target volume concentrates further if he sits or is limited.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Rams pass-catchers and TEs if limited or out.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially did not practice for a second straight day due to hamstring.
items.why: Continued hamstring recovery; missed since Week 4 tweak.
items.implication: Likely OUT or high risk for Week 7 vs SEA; monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: More targets for other KC WRs/TE if inactive.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back/in-line to play Week 7 vs DAL (Berry RB15); efficient in full games played; Dallas strong RB matchup.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone vs soft DAL front.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (Jets Thursday injury report).
items.implication: Positive step toward Week 7 availability vs MIA.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list, a significant move; corresponding IR for TE Elijah Arroyo (shoulder surgery, season).
items.why: Completed 21-day window after ACL rehab; full practice Wed.
items.implication: Eligible Week 7 vs KC; likely limited early workload as flex/handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: RB committee share with residual backs; goal-line potential.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad amid OL mess. Discussed long-term outlook on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access + poor backup efficiency data signal quick ramp to lead role.
items.implication: Strong ROS RB2+ upside once fully integrated; Week 7 may be shared but positive.
items.conflict: Berry hates Week 7 due to layoff ramp risk.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (after limited Wed work).
items.implication: On track for Week 7 expected play.

items.text: Notable: Terrance Ferguson (eligible off IR next week) not expected ready soon ('will take some time'). Biggest Adams beneficiary delayed, so Rams' answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Adams long-term hamstring out + Ferguson delay leaves vacuum.
items.implication: Elite WR1 volume floor/ceiling even higher short-term; calf now clouds.
items.conflict: New calf injury may suppress if limited/out.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS landing spot uncertainty; hold for now.

items.text: LOVE Matthew Golden (@DET, deep targets leader vs Lions 3rd-highest deep completion %) and Tucker Kraft (@DET, TE6): Lions defense fantasy buffet for pass-catchers.
items.why: Deep target volume + soft Lions secondary.
items.implication: Upside WR/TE plays in high-total GB-DET.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown (@CHI, WR10) and DeVonta Smith (vs DAL, WR11): Brown elite target share/routes (97%) despite drops; Smith volume; Bears defense allows yardage.
LOVE Jaylen Warren (@NO RB9), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB RB10), Bucky Irving (@CAR RB12): big workloads in friendly matchups; defenses carved by RBs.
HATE Josh Jacobs (@DET RB18: workload question after layoff), Rome Odunze (vs NE WR32), Josh Downs (@MIN WR41), Travis Kelce (@SEA TE9), Cam Skattebo (@HOU RB37): ramp/role/matchup issues.
items.why: Layoff ramp for Jacobs; tough matchups/roles for others.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive long-term on Jacobs vs poor backups.
